D.t: Rebecca Cooke leads by 3.6 in the forecast and wins 73% of simulations. The cushion is about 13,722 votes; a one point swing is about 1,880 voters changing sides.

R.t: Derrick Van Orden trails by 3.6 and wins 27% of simulations. Closing it takes about 6,861 voters switching sides, or 13,722 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +10.9 and R +3.5. A normal polling error decides it.
$4.7M cash against $1.8M. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
